content_html: Some regular readers have alerted me to the fact that the Blogger lightbox for images isn't working. This is a photo-heavy blog, so that's a problem. Although I use a lightly modified basic theme, I did a test post with a current theme and it still didn't work, on Edge, Firefox, Safari and Chrome, so I don't think it's something I did. The offender appears to be, in the minified JS, a couple instances of things like <tt>var Zp={}.getUniqueId("photofactoryservice");</tt> which is of course nonsense because you can't get <s>blood</s> a function from a <s>turnip</s> empty object and I don't see an obvious proto that would provide it. I also looked at a few other blogs and they seem to be similarly affected, so I think this is global and the whole thing feels like a flubbed deploy that didn't get enough testing. In the meantime, you can right click on an image and open it in a new tab to see the larger version, or you can use the mobile view (append <tt>?m=1</tt> to the URL) which doesn't use the lightbox at all. Happy Thanksgiving, I guess.
